violated_contract: Each debug log record must be persisted as one complete JSON line. Concurrent asynchronous file appends, rotation truncations or clears must not interleave or overwrite an in-flight record.
canonical_prevention: Route all log file writes through one in-order asynchronous queue that covers initialization, rotation and the complete append, and enqueue explicit clears on that same queue. Swallow each operation's file errors inside the queue so a failed write cannot prevent later records from being written.
